exposure: clinical fetal weight estimation methods (Johnson's and Dare's formulae)
cohort: 110 term cephalic singleton pregnancies delivered within 24 hours of fetal weight estimation at a Tertiary hospital in Abakaliki, Nigeria.
finding: The sonographic method demonstrated significantly higher accuracy in fetal weight estimation within 10% of actual birth weight (68.2%) compared to clinical methods (Johnson's 23.6%, Dare's 26.4%).
